subject: Regional phased activation playbook — decisions & owners
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Regional phased activation playbook — decisions & owners

Team —

I want to lock down the playbook for the upcoming phased activation (Acme pilot -> US general -> EU follow-up). High level asks below; I’m aiming to finalize owners and a decision log by EOD Monday so engineering can freeze rollout flags and training slots.

Key decision areas (please propose owner + one-sentence approach):
- Activation tiers: what defines Tier A vs Tier B customers for the phased onramp? (safety-net thresholds, allowed rate limits)
- Safety-net flagging: per-account canary + automatic rollback triggers — who owns the rollback policy and what metrics trigger it?
- Docs & SDK: minimal dev docs vs full SDK packaging; do we ship a slim SDK for pilot? Translation cadence for EU.
- Enablement & training: schedule two office hours (pilot week + scale week) — who will lead?
- Support & on-call: escalation matrix for high-severity incidents during ramp.

Attachments: activation_tiers.xlsx (draft tiers), sdk_packaging_notes.pdf (options), infra-constraints.md (ops notes). Drive links below.

Quick asks: please reply with owner assignment + a single-line decision by EOD Monday 6/1. If you need to loop in additional people (Security, CS), state it here.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Regional phased activation playbook — decisions & owners

Rishi — thanks for the clear asks. Quick responses and owners below (I’ll update the shared sheet with the decision log).

- Activation tiers (owner: Marissa Cole): propose Tier A = <50k gen tokens/day + enterprise support contract; Tier B = <500k gen tokens/day trial customers. Tier A gets per-account canary; Tier B gets pool-level throttling.
- Safety-net flagging (owner: Vivek Kulkarni for infra policy; Marissa for customer policy): rollback trigger = error rate > 5% sustained for 3m OR latency p95 > 3s for 5m. Auto-fallback to smaller model variant.
- Docs & SDK (owner: Marissa Cole + Docs squad): ship slim SDK (pip package with minimal deps) for pilot; full SDK + examples in sprint following pilot. EU translation: defer until post-pilot, but publish key API pages first; target EN->FR/DE within 3 weeks.
- Enablement (owner: Marissa Cole): I will run pilot office hours (Tue 6/8 10am PT) and scale-week training (Thu 6/24 2pm PT).
- Support & on-call (owner: Grace O'Connor): propose dedicated on-call rotation for rollout week with CS + SRE + Prod Eng.

I’ll ping Sarah at Acme to confirm pilot window next week and get their list of Tier A accounts.

Attachments: I flagged items in activation_tiers.xlsx with recommended thresholds.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Marketing, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Regional phased activation playbook — decisions & owners

Thanks — quick infra constraints and asks from my side:

- Capacity: current Dedicated pools can handle the pilot plus 3x burst for 24h windows. For US general we need to provision extra reserved capacity by 6/10; estimate attached in infra-constraints.md.
- Rollback automation: SRE can implement the automated fallback to smaller model variant (and circuit breaker) but we need explicit thresholds (Marissa’s thresholds look reasonable). Need a single owner to approve any automatic customer-impacting rollback — suggest Prod Eng manager.
- Monitoring/playbook: I’ll own the monitoring runbook. Need the final list of metrics and alert thresholds by 6/2 so I can wire the dashboards and alert routing.

Cc’d Grace because we’ll need CS runbooks for customer comms when we flip flags.

On the SDK packaging: keep the slim package minimal — avoid heavy C bindings for pilot; full native build can come later.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Infrastructure Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Regional phased activation playbook — decisions & owners

Putting this together into a short action list and decisions for Monday’s sync. Quoted below are the key items pulled from the thread.

DECISIONS (to record in the playbook)
- Tier definitions: Tier A = <50k tokens/day + contract (owner: Marissa). Tier B = <500k tokens/day trial (owner: Marissa).
- Rollback triggers: error rate >5% sustained 3m OR p95 latency >3s for 5m (infra owner: Vivek; policy owner: Marissa).
- SDK: ship slim pip package for pilot; full SDK post-pilot (owner: Marissa).
- Training: pilot office hours Tue 6/8 10am PT; scale training Thu 6/24 2pm PT (owner: Marissa).
- On-call: dedicated rollout rota for onboarding week (owner: Grace).

ACTIONS (owners + due dates)
- Marissa: update activation_tiers.xlsx with final thresholds and publish decision log (due 2026-06-01).
- Vivek: finalize monitoring runbook and wire dashboards (due 2026-06-02).
- Grace: create CS incident templates + escalation matrix and share with SRE (due 2026-06-03).
- Rishi: confirm pilot list with Acme and get sign-off on dates (due 2026-06-01).

Open questions for Monday:
- Who is the Prod Eng manager sign-off for auto-rollbacks? (Rishi, pls propose).
- Do we enable per-account canary for Tier B or keep pool-level for scale simplicity? (Marissa to weigh tradeoffs).

I’ll consolidate the playbook doc into the Drive folder and create a short run-of-show for pilot week. If anyone needs me to draft the CS messages, ping me and I’ll do the first pass.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
